links.outcome: Readability of LLM pulmonary embolism education responses versus sixth-grade benchmarks
links.effect: No model met sixth-grade readability standards; median grade-level indices ranged from approximately 9 to 16; median FRES 34.80 to 47.90.
links.quote: No model met sixth-grade readability standards.

links.outcome: Reading level of LLM patient-education text relative to recommended level
links.effect: Every model produced text above recommended patient-education reading levels; median grade-level indices approximately 9 to 16.
links.quote: Copilot and Perplexity scored better on structural quality and attribution, yet every model produced text above recommended patient-education reading levels.

screen.reason: Evaluates four commercial LLMs on patient education for pulmonary embolism, testing reliability, quality, and readability metrics, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
